name: wds_imagenet1k
description: A web-distilled ImageNet-1k benchmark derived for evaluating vision models (notably CLIP-style models) on standard ImageNet-1k classes. It provides images and labels for measuring image classification and representation learning performance under web-collected data conditions. Commonly used to benchmark zero-shot and supervised top-1 accuracy of visual encoders.
reputation: Used in the CLIP/vision-model benchmarking community as a web-sourced ImageNet-1k variant; moderate adoption for representation evaluation.
